results.why: delete the same-seed arm: every volatile subject becomes a hash-order finding, which is exactly the state of the two live runners in this tree
a scrub set too WIDE: masks every leaf, so a real cross-seed difference is swallowed and reported green
align a shape change instead of refusing it: `unscrubbable` disappears and the instrument invents an answer
the perturbation check always passes: a dead arm reports a clean bill of health
the classic off-by-one in the power formula, understating the miss probability by a factor of n
drop the exit code from the compared payload: a deriver that answers 0 and 1 in different processes reports stable
run the control ONCE and duplicate the result: the control can never disagree with itself, so it always licenses the seed claim
a registry `expect` that disagrees with the measurement stops being an error: the registry becomes a to-do list again
